db_host.description: Hostname or IP of the PostgreSQL server.

db_port.description: Port number of the PostgreSQL server.

db_name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database used by Davical.

db_password.description: Password for the database user (store securely in production—e.g., via environment variables or secrets).

site_url.description: Publicly accessible base URL for this Davical instance (including protocol and trailing slash).

default_lang.description: Default language for the interface (ISO 639-1 two-letter code).

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to syslog or PHP error log (disable in production).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent database connections allowed.

force_https.description: Redirect all requests to HTTPS and enforce secure cookies (recommended for production).

allow_basic_auth.description: Allow HTTP Basic authentication (needed for older clients; avoid if OAuth or certs are used).

allow_ssl_client_cert_auth.description: Enable authentication via SSL client certificates.

allow_new_users.description: Allow new user registration via the web UI (disabled by default in most production deployments).

default_user_role.description: Default role assigned to newly created users (e.g., 'user' or 'admin').

allowed_domains.description: List of allowed email domains for self-registration (empty = all domains allowed). Each item is an email domain (e.g., 'example.com').

cal_prefix.description: URL path prefix for user calendars (must end with '/').

addr_prefix.description: URL path prefix for address books (must end with '/').

use_apc.description: Use APC/uOPcache for PHP opcode caching (enabled by default).

davical_htdocs_path.description: Document root path for the DAViCal web application.

davical_etc_path.description: Configuration directory path for DAViCal settings (e.g., config.inc.php).
